core_nearly_full: Your soul core is nearly saturated. Change is close.
The core strains against its limit. Soon it will hold no more.

core_nearly_full.text: Your core is nearly full. The candle waits for you.
{true_name}, your core is nearly saturated. The threads around you pull tighter.

core_full: Your soul core is saturated. It can hold no more as it is.

core_full.text: Your core is saturated. Light the candle, and Awaken.
Your core is saturated. A Nightmare of the {next_category} Category is all that stands between you and Ascension.
{true_name}, your core is saturated. The Spell is waiting to see what you do with it.

seed_next_category: A Seed of the {category} Category grows nearby. It has been waiting for you.
Something stirs in the dream near you: a Nightmare of the {category} Category.
The Seed nearby calls to a soul of your rank. Answer it, or do not.

seed_next_category.text: {true_name}. A Seed of the {category} Category grows nearby, and it has heard of you.

new_region: You have entered {region}. The threads here are thinner.
You have entered {region}. Things of the {danger} rank walk here.

new_region.text: {region}. The threads here know your name, {true_name}.

unclaimed_citadel: A Citadel stands nearby with no master: {citadel}.
{citadel} waits for someone to claim it.

unclaimed_citadel.text: {citadel} has lost its Guardian. Its Gateway lies open.
{citadel} stands without a master. A bearer of a True Name could hold it.

idle: The Spell is patient. It is also watching.
Your soul is still. The Dream Realm is not.
Your next step will not take itself.

idle.text: {true_name}. Names fade when no one adds to them.

name_spoken: Someone has spoken your True Name. They know where you stand.
Your True Name was spoken. For a moment, someone felt where you are.

name_spoken.text: {true_name}. Someone has called on it, and it answered with your place in the world.

citadel_raid: {citadel} is under attack. A Seed of the {category} Category has bloomed at its walls.
The dream comes for {citadel}. Its Gateway will not hold itself.

citadel_raid.text: {true_name}. {citadel} is under attack, and the Spell wants to see who answers.
